_comment: The game's audio boundary (docs/OPENAL_MIGRATION_PLAN.md section 1): entry hooks on its sound manager's methods, each answered by the native sound manager on OpenAL Soft (port/audio_hooks.cpp). Lifted beside config/r8_hooks.json (tools/r8_lift.sh, tools/setup_pipeline.py). FMOD's API hooks, M0's baseline, went with FMOD itself (M5: config/excluded_code.json).
